themes.evidence: Build semantic data models that expose customer tables to natural language queries via Cortex Analyst.
construct the semantic layer between raw data and AI agents... the metrics, dimensions, and relationships that AI agents need to reason correctly
owns the full data stack from source ingestion to semantic layer
you are the translation layer... output makes sense to a business leader who has never opened a terminal
build the data foundations that power Snowflake's AI platform
design rigorous data models, build and instrument pipelines... develop automated testing procedures for Snowflake data models

archetype_rationale: The role is literally 'forward-deployed; onsite at customer sites,' embedding directly with customer data/analytics/business teams to build foundations and acting as 'the translation layer.' Day-to-day it ships data/semantic engineering inside client engagements, which is the defining FDE / client-facing pattern over a pure backend data-engineering role.
notes: Hard gate: 5+ years in analytics/data engineering with a customer-facing or cross-functional slice — evidence the customer-facing portion. Stated baseline (not nice-to-have): daily use of an AI coding assistant as primary dev tool — lead with Claude-Code/agent-builder projects. Onsite/relocation to Menlo Park is real. Responses managed off LinkedIn — apply via Snowflake channel. Considered but dropped: ML-pipeline (work is data pipelines, not ML training); cross-functional (subsumed by business-translation + FDE archetype).
